'''Monchantics''' was a company that was led by the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] entrepreneur and [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] interface designer [[Sibs Monchan]]. The company earned hundreds of millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and at the [[Time/Legends|time]] that Monchan undertook a cruiser aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'', Monchantics was a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] away from launching an initial public offering on the [[Mileva Stock Exchange]].
